jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FIELDGUIDE

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.




THE ROLE

We are hiring a hands-on FP&A Manager to serve as the analytical engine of our planning, reporting, and decision support. You will own core planning cycles and the reporting that goes to our executive team and board, build the KPI infrastructure that tells us how the business is really performing, and support the strategic work that comes with scaling toward IPO. This role begins as an individual contributor with a clear path to building and leading a team as the function grows.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Support the annual budget process, quarterly reforecasts, and the rolling operating model, including revenue, headcount, and expense builds.

 - Prepare monthly and quarterly reporting packages with variance analysis and written commentary that explains the drivers, not just the deltas.

 - Build and maintain board and investor reporting materials in partnership with the Head of FP&A and the VP of Finance.

 - Track and improve the integrity of our SaaS efficiency metrics: CAC and payback, magic number, gross margin, and burn efficiency.

 - Improve our planning and reporting infrastructure, including the systems, data flows, and source-of-truth definitions that connect our ERP, CRM, and planning tools.

 - Partner with department leaders on headcount planning, spend management, and monthly budget reviews.

 - Build models that support strategic decisions such as pricing and packaging, product investment cases, fundraising, and evaluation of inorganic opportunities.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5-8 years in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, or consulting, with meaningful exposure to high-growth SaaS. Depth of ownership matters more to us than years served.

 - Advanced financial modeling skills and expert fluency in Excel or Google Sheets, with the judgment to know when a model should be simple.

 - Working knowledge of modern planning tools (for example Pigment, Runway, Mosaic, or Anaplan) and comfort with SQL or BI tools is a plus.

 - A strong command of accounting fundamentals and how they shape planning, reporting, and revenue recognition.

 - Clear written and verbal communication. You can distill a complex analysis into a recommendation that a non-finance leader can act on.

 - A high degree of ownership and comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.

More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Us
Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.



About the Role

We are looking for a performance marketer who is still in the accounts.

You will own paid as a growth engine at Fieldguide: paid search, paid social, third-party media, landing page conversion, and the website as a demand tool. You will own the budget, the tests, the measurement, and the number. Our ambition is for paid to deliver 30 to 50% of high-quality MQLs and 30% of total pipeline. Today it delivers a fraction of that, which means the upside here is unusually clear.

This is a hands-to-keyboard seat at a senior level. You will build and optimize, not brief an agency and report back. You will work alongside a peer who owns campaign demand (webinars, nurture, email), so you can go deep on performance rather than spreading thin.

Two things we will be honest about. Our attribution is mid-rebuild, so part of this job is closing the measurement gap rather than inheriting a clean dashboard. And conversion optimization is coming back in-house, which means the testing program is yours to build rather than inherit. If either of those reads as a problem rather than an opportunity, this is not the seat.

You are also someone who uses AI daily. Not as a novelty, but because you have built workflows that let one person do what a team used to.



What You'll Do

Own paid search. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads end to end: keyword and query strategy, bid management, ad copy, negatives hygiene, and landing page pairing. Drive CPA down and pipeline efficiency up, and be able to name the changes that did it.

Own paid social. LinkedIn Ads end to end: audiences, creative testing, bidding, conversion tracking, and lead handoff. Build into emerging paid surfaces where the ICP actually is.

Own third-party media and paid distribution. Programmatic display, native, OLV, DOOH, and content syndication, including the agency and trading desk relationships behind them.

Own the conversion surface. Landing page performance, CRO test roadmap, the demo request path, form and gating strategy, and the website as a demand gen tool. Run the testing program in-house.

Own the budget. Allocation across channels, in-quarter reallocation on a two-week read, monthly forecast versus actual, and agency spend management. Bring a kill-or-scale recommendation per channel and per vendor every quarter.

Close the measurement gap. Build full-funnel paid measurement: attribution model, event-based tracking, and a clean line from spend to pipeline to revenue, in partnership with our RevOps and Marketing Ops teams.

Use AI to multiply output. Ask whether AI can do the first 80% of every task. Build agentic monitoring that catches a spend or performance anomaly before a human notices. Share the workflows so the leverage compounds.




Who You Are

 - You have 5+ years in B2B performance or growth marketing, with clear ownership of a paid budget and a pipeline number.

 - You have experience at the scale we are operating at: monthly paid spend and pipeline contribution in the range we are scaling into, not a few thousand dollars a month.

 - You have hands-on, hands-to-keyboard paid experience. You have personally built, structured, and optimized paid search and paid social campaigns recently. You can walk someone into your account and explain the last three changes you made and why.

 - You have full-funnel and revenue thinking. You can trace a paid dollar to MQL, SQL, SQO, and closed revenue, and you argue about efficiency rather than volume.

 - You have real experience with attribution models and event-based tracking, ideally in an environment where the data was not clean.

 - You have in-house CRO and landing page testing experience: cadence, backlog prioritization, and an honest win rate.

 - You have HubSpot fluency, plus the ad platforms: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

 - You have vendor and agency management with teeth. You can hold an agency to a hypothesis and a metric, and end an engagement that isn't earning it.

 - You have a specific, demonstrable AI practice in paid execution. You can show us the workflow, the inputs, and what it replaced.

 - You hold yourself to a high bar. You are the first quality check on your own work, and you measure it against the best in the category, not against your last campaign.

 - You have B2B experience with a considered, multi-stakeholder sale. Professional services, accounting, audit, or fintech is a plus. B2C or PLG-only is not a fit.



What Great Looks Like Here

We measure ourselves by outcomes, not effort. Opinions start the conversation; data ends it. Every program has a hypothesis, a metric, and an honest read, and we kill or scale on evidence.

If that sounds like the way you already work, we should talk.



More about Fieldguide:

 - Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable -  Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.



Some of our benefits include:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits starting your first day

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT FIELDGUIDE

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners with AI agents. They are based in San Francisco and have raised over $125M+ in venture funding from top Silicon Valley investors to accomplish their ambitious vision, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

Fieldguide has become the defining agentic company for CPAs, with more than 50%+ of the top-100 CPA firms as customers, including several Big 4, and an industry-leading NPS to match. They save up to 75% of time on manual tasks and unlock over 4x capacity for audit practitioners, helping provide the work-life balance that is rare in the profession. Fieldguide is on the same growth curve as the later-stage vertical AI leaders, but you would be joining early enough to have a meaningful impact.

Fieldguide values diversity, both in backgrounds and in experiences to help build the future of audit and advisory. They are deliberate in preserving a winning culture with their FFLOWI values - Fearless, Fast, Lovable, Owners, Win-Win, Inclusive - providing space for teammates to do their career’s best work through a tightly-knit support network.

If you want to shape the most important shift in how commerce and capital markets establish trust, alongside world-class teammates, Fieldguide would love to build with you.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Fieldguide is hiring a Strategic Partnerships Director to own the activation and scaling of our growing partner ecosystem. Reporting to the Head of Operations, you’ll manage technology partnerships, referral channels and system integrators, turning strategic relationships into measurable pipeline and revenue. This is a high-visibility, zero-to-one execution role - motions are still early-stage, playbooks need to be built, and success will require strategic thinking with world-class execution.

The position is located remotely in the United States, with ~20% travel required.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own end-to-end activation of the partner ecosystem across technology, methodology, referral, alliance, and system integrator partners, driving joint enablement, co-sell motions, and pipeline tracking for key GTM partners.

 - Build and manage referral partner programs from scratch, establishing systematic cadences, pipeline tracking, attribution management for referral fees, and proactive partner-to-customer introductions.

 - Collaborate with the alliances function on driving referrals across CPA alliances and networks to accelerate our global presence..

 - Drive partnership revenue in collaboration Collaborate with cross-functional executive leadership, helping recommend fit on evaluating new partnerships and structures based on market analysis and strategic fit.

 - Build repeatable partner activation playbooks to scale the partnerships function in collaboration with partner marketing, across onboarding, enablement, joint marketing, and revenue tracking.


ABOUT YOU

 - 4-8+ years of experience building and executing partner programs that generate measurable revenue and pipeline across technology, referral, or channel partners.

 -  2–5 years of corporate finance, PE/VC, or business operations experience, giving you the first-principles analytical thinking needed to structure partnerships, evaluate tradeoffs, and build business cases. 

 - Demonstrated ownership of revenue or pipeline targets, with clear examples of driving partnerships to successful outcomes. 

 - Entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable building from zero, thriving in ambiguity, and shipping fast.

 - Strong project management discipline for orchestrating cross-functional initiatives.

 - Executive presence: able to present confidently to C-suite stakeholders and partner leadership.

 - Analytical rigor, including comfort leveraging AI tooling to accelerate workflows and scale output.


BONUS POINTS

 - Prior Series B–D stage startup experience.

 - Background in accounting, audit, or compliance tech.

 - PE or VC investing experience.




FIELDGUIDE IS A VALUES-BASED COMPANY. OUR VALUES ARE:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive equity package at a high-growth, Series C startup

 - Comprehensive wellness benefits, including a bundle of free therapy sessions

 - Flexible time off and remote-first work environment

 - Technology and home office reimbursements

 - Twice-yearly in-person team offsites

 - 401k

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, highly organized Event Manager to lead the planning and execution of our conference and trade show portfolio. This role will own the end-to-end event lifecycle - from sponsorship evaluation and pre-event strategy through onsite execution, lead follow-up, and performance reporting.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional operator who understands how to turn industry events into meaningful opportunities to build brand awareness, strengthen customer and partner relationships, and create and accelerate pipeline.






What You'll Do

 - Help define the strategy, planning, and execution of conferences, trade shows, sponsorships, and related field experiences.

 - Manage all event logistics, including sponsorship deliverables, booth production, vendors, shipping, registration, staffing, travel, and onsite operations.

 - Develop event objectives, audience strategies, activation plans, timelines, budgets, and success metrics.

 - Partner with Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Executive Leadership to align each event with business priorities.

 - Create integrated pre-event, onsite, and post-event engagement plans that increase attendance, drive qualified conversations, and accelerate opportunities.

 - Lead booth strategy and experience design, including messaging, demonstrations, meetings, executive engagements, and branded activations.

 - Identify opportunities for ancillary experiences, including executive dinners, customer gatherings, partner events, and strategic prospect meetings.

 - Manage speaker submissions, session logistics, presentation requirements, and thought-leadership opportunities.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for conference organizers, venues, production partners, agencies, and other vendors.

 - Prepare internal event briefs, staffing plans, executive communications, training materials, and onsite run-of-show documents.

 - Ensure event leads are accurately captured, routed, and followed up on in partnership with Sales and Marketing Operations.

 - Measure event performance against defined KPIs, including engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, opportunity acceleration, and return on investment.

 - Lead post-event debriefs and translate insights into recommendations for future investment and program optimization.

 - Maintain the annual event calendar and manage multiple programs simultaneously while ensuring deadlines, budgets, and brand standards are met.

 - Travel regularly to provide hands-on leadership and onsite execution.
   
   

Who You Are

 - 3+ years of experience managing conferences, trade shows, sponsorships, or B2B field marketing programs.

 - Ability to lift, move, and transport event materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

 - Proven success managing complex, high-visibility events from strategy through execution.

 - Strong understanding of how events support brand awareness, thought leadership, pipeline creation, and opportunity acceleration.

 - Exceptional project management, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills.

 - Experience managing budgets, contracts, vendors, agencies, and production partners.

 - Ability to collaborate effectively with sales teams, executives, partners, speakers, and external stakeholders.

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and overlapping deadlines.

 - Experience with CRM, marketing automation, project management, and event technology platforms.

 - Willingness to travel approximately 30–40%, including occasional evenings and weekends.






Bonus Points

 - Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, accounting, audit, risk, or professional services.

 - Experience developing executive experiences, customer events, and partner activations alongside major conferences.

 - Familiarity with attribution, pipeline reporting, lead management, and event ROI analysis.

 - Experience managing national or international conference portfolios.
